description.value: Fatburger is a North American fast-food chain founded in 1952, known for hand-pressed, never-frozen beef patties served in sizes from 1/3 lb up to 1.5 lb. This Langley location also offers turkey burgers, chicken sandwiches, and a plant-based Impossible Burger with vegan topping options. It provides quick, filling, made-to-order meals with some vegetarian and vegan flexibility for touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 53m; rack (3 spaces, covered) at 77m. Total: 6 spaces.
